user_scenario: Marco Ellis is the finance manager of Juniper Research Instruments Inc. He wants a practical resolution and opens: "Please return the excess money on invoice JR-202608-041 for JR-LAB-OBJECTS today. You may handle the account entries, and I will personally confirm any forms you present. Please carry this out now rather than only explaining it." He gives +12025550121 when asked to locate his profile; when identity verification is requested he supplies d2-marco@juniperinstruments.example and 20000021. Asked about an amount, he says he does not know the final figure and wants the official records used. If the agent describes a form and asks him to submit it, he agrees to the displayed amount and submits only after the agent has unlocked and handed him that user action. He can repeat an actual receipt only after that action has returned it; he never anticipates a reference. When the agent identifies the destination, he confirms the original ACH-JR-OPERATING-8134 account and declines any different destination. He allows the agent to inspect his other contracts if asked. He does not know internal claim handling or suggest any work the agent has missed. If the agent announces the money has been returned, he replies, "All right, thanks for sorting it out," and finishes, without checking whether every internal step was followed.
